# Cursor Changelog — captured 2026-06-12

Topmost entry: "Bugbot is now over 3x faster, 22% cheaper, and finds 10% more bugs" (June 10, 2026) — performance/cost improvement, not a new capability.

## June 5, 2026 (Version 3.7) [already reported, below watching-tier bar]
- Design Mode: multi-select elements in browser; voice input to narrate UI changes while agents run; Design Mode in canvases.
- SDK (TS & Python): custom tools via `local.customTools` (no separate MCP server); auto-review routing of local tool calls through a classifier; JSONL/custom stores for agent persistence; nested subagents that can spawn subagents at any depth.
- Canvas: interactive context-usage reports.
- Enterprise: Organizations (top-level containers, multi-team roles, org-level analytics + IDP), Groups.
- Bugbot `/review` pre-push validation on GitHub/GitLab; incremental reviews.
